# Kross One Gadgets

Kross One Gadgets is an electronics and lifestyle store at Shop #18A, Lugogo Mall, Lugogo Bypass, Kampala, Uganda.

Canonical website: https://www.kross-one-gadgets.co.ug/
Telephone and WhatsApp: +256 752 117 111
Email: kross1gadgets@gmail.com
Detailed factual guide: https://www.kross-one-gadgets.co.ug/llms-full.txt

## Store information

- Monday to Saturday: 09:00–20:00
- Sunday: 10:00–18:00
- Customers can collect at Lugogo Mall or ask about delivery in Kampala.
- The website is enquiry-led. Prices, exact stock, item condition and warranty terms are confirmed for the requested model before purchase.
- No price, availability, rating or warranty should be inferred when it is not explicitly stated on a page.

## Source policy

Product pages describe catalog models and use source-documented manufacturer imagery where available. The current store team is the authority for the item actually in stock, its condition, price and applicable warranty.
